prompt:
Contemporary 2D digital animation still, flat cel-shaded technique. Crisp focal contours contrasted with heavy depth-of-field blur on peripheral abstract shapes. Matte rendering fused with emissive glowing elements and fluid geometric abstraction. Hyper-saturated psychedelic neon palette dominated by vivid magenta, crimson, cyan, and lime. Radial volumetric lighting with intense central high-key bloom and dramatic backlighting. Post-processing features cinematic lens blur, prominent edge halation, and subtle digital grain. Neo-psychedelic surrealist movement conveying a chaotic, dynamic, and intensely vivid mood.
Negatives: photorealism, 3D render, CGI, thick ink outlines, muted palette, grayscale, traditional oil painting, gritty realism, soft watercolor fade, crosshatching

promptZh:
当代 2D 数字动画静帧，扁平赛璐珞渲染技术。清晰的焦点轮廓与外围抽象形状的强景深模糊形成对比。哑光渲染与发光元素及流体几何抽象融合。超饱和 以鲜艳的洋红色、深红色、青色和酸橙色为主的迷幻霓虹色调。径向体积光，中心具有强烈的明亮光晕和戏剧性的背光效果。后期处理包含电影级镜头模糊、突出的边缘光晕和细腻的数字噪点。新迷幻超现实主义运动，传达出混乱、动态且极其生动的氛围。
负面提示词：照片写实、3D 渲染、CGI、粗墨线、柔和色调、灰度、传统油画、粗粝写实、柔和水彩晕染、交叉排线
